research.title: Position and location: Year 6: Planning tool
research.organization: Mathematics Hub / Australian Government / Education Services Australia
research.retrieval: Actual public HTML read: overview, teaching and learning, misconceptions and assessment suggestions. No linked solution PDFs or GeoGebra activities run.
research.adopted: Two perpendicular signed number lines; origin; x first, y second; meaningful plotting and reading with misconceptions about signs and swapped coordinates.
research.rejected: No compulsory point-letter naming, race, fixed walking route or complete process certification. Foreign curriculum sequence is not a Finnish prerequisite rule.
research.usageRestrictions: Terms HTML separately retrieved: default Commonwealth of Australia CC BY4.0 except logos, trademarks and identified third-party material. No supplied prose/figures copied.
research.scopeLimits: Planning comparison, not observed effectiveness or formal rubric of this project.

research.adopted: Keep original diagrams and record excluded logos/third-party material.

research.title: Introducing the Cartesian coordinate system — Teacher resources, page 1
research.organization: Australian Mathematical Sciences Institute / Education Services Australia
research.retrieval: Actual 19-line public HTML read including origin, perpendicular axes, ordered pair and top-left example. Terms_of_use.html link attempted but cache miss; licence not established.
research.adopted: Conceptual corroboration of axes/origin and ordered coordinate pairs. Original geometry and Finnish explanation.
research.rejected: Do not copy figure/prose or infer a licence from failed terms retrieval. No all-real-coordinate coverage from a finite integer model.
research.usageRestrictions: Licence unavailable in this retrieval; conceptual comparison only, no copying.
research.scopeLimits: No efficacy, Finnish curriculum or complete process claim.

research.title: Negative numbers: counting, comparing and calculating
research.retrieval: Actual public HTML introduction and six teaching points read. Linked 31-page guide retrieved but parser produced largely unreadable bullet glyphs; no claim of reading guide pages/slides.
research.adopted: Equal unit intervals, zero reference, negative to the left; magnitude as distance from zero, signed positions and a contextual height link.
research.rejected: No full negative arithmetic curriculum, prescribed English vocabulary or mastery/efficacy claim. No text/art/code copied.
research.usageRestrictions: NCETM copyright HTML retrieved separately: default Crown copyright/Open Government Licence except stated; attribution and named-author/third-party exceptions apply. Original Finnish text/SVG/code only.
research.scopeLimits: Comparable primary teaching resource, not new Finnish curriculum authority or learner observation.
